subject: Stale GCP Marketplace Invoices — collection queue escalation & evidence bundle
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Oct 2026 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: Stale GCP Marketplace invoices — collection queue escalation & evidence request

Team,

We have an emerging problem: a set of GCP marketplace invoices from Acme Apps (account on HS-2394) hit our collection queue and have been sitting >60 days. AR flagged them overnight as "stale" and Finance is asking for a coordinated evidence bundle so we can either clear the holds or proceed to collections.

Key invoice IDs flagged: GCP-INV-2026-0874 ($98,412.50 incl. VAT), GCP-INV-2026-0891 ($22,300.00), GCP-INV-2026-0910 ($4,125.00). Several have VAT lines that don't match the seller tax invoices — Acme is in the UK but the VAT treatment was applied inconsistently.

Immediate asks (owners):
- Marissa: assemble meter-level CSVs (daily usage & timestamps) + the ledger export we submitted to GCP for these billing periods. Attach to the thread.
- Jordan: provide AR aging, invoice creation timestamps, and any payment attempt logs we have from our PSP.
- Vanessa: reach out to GCP contacts and confirm whether their marketplace metering stamps align to the invoice timestamps (specifically for INV-2026-0874). Also check whether withholding codes were applied by any reseller routing.

We need a complete evidence bundle within 48 hours to avoid auto-escalation to collections. If we cannot produce clear meter evidence + remittance trace from Acme, Finance will instruct us to raise a collections case and notify the partner.

I am looping in Acme (via Marissa's next email) once we have the candidate invoice list — we should ask them for the wire trace and VAT invoice with breakdown.

Karthik
Head of Marketplace Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: GCP Billing Ops <gcp-billing@google.com>, Acme Payments <acme-payments@acme.com>, Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@acme-apps.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Oct 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Stale GCP Marketplace invoices — collection queue escalation & evidence request

Hi all,

Thanks Karthik — attaching the candidate invoices and an AR aging export so everyone has the canonical list (attachments below).

Attachments:
- aging-spreadsheet.csv (Redwood AR aging view)
- candidate_invoices_list.txt (invoice IDs & amounts)

GCP / Acme: can you confirm the following for each invoice in the list?
1) GCP: metering report (meter ids + event timestamps) that map to the invoice lines for INV-2026-0874, -0891, -0910. We specifically need the per-day usage stamps for Sep 28–Oct 02.
2) Acme: remittance/wire trace for any payments attempted against these invoice IDs. If a payment failed, include bank reject codes or beneficiary shortfall reasons.
3) Tax: Acme needs to provide VAT invoices with supplier tax ID and VAT amount per line. Our tax team cannot net the VAT without supplier-supplied tax invoices.

We are operating on a 48-hour evidence window from the time of this email. If we have incomplete evidence after that, Finance will request a collections referral. Please reply with attachments inline where possible.

Thanks — Marissa
Director, Billing & Marketplaces
Redwood Inference

From: GCP Billing Ops <gcp-billing@google.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Acme Payments <acme-payments@acme.com>, Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@acme-apps.com>

Date: Mon, 19 Oct 2026 11:40:00 -0700

Marissa / team,

On Mon, Oct 19, 2026 at 09:02 AM Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com> wrote:
> GCP / Acme: can you confirm the following for each invoice in the list?

See attached meter export and the PDF copies we have on file for the flagged invoices. We confirm metering events for INV-2026-0874 with event timestamps between 2026-09-29T02:14:00Z and 2026-10-02T22:57:00Z. The attached gcp-metering-report-202610.csv maps the meter id to usage lines.

Attachments:
- gcp-metering-report-202610.csv (meter id, usage_ts_utc, quantity)
- gcp-invoice-2026-0874.pdf (seller invoice copy we generated)

Notes:
- We do not have visibility into Acme's remittance wiring (that must come from customer/merchant bank).
- The seller VAT invoice is uploaded by the partner; if Acme has not provided VAT line items to the marketplace, that will need to be supplied by them.

If you want, we can also pull the raw pubsub metering event payloads for deeper matching, but that'll take ~24 hours — let us know.

Regards,
GCP Billing Ops

From: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@acme-apps.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, GCP Billing Ops <gcp-billing@google.com>, Acme Payments <acme-payments@acme.com>

Date: Mon, 19 Oct 2026 14:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Stale GCP Marketplace invoices — collection queue escalation & evidence request

Hi Marissa / team,

Thanks for the heads up. Payment update: our treasury attempted a wire on 2026-10-02 for the bulk amount but the receiving intermediary rejected it due to an incomplete beneficiary address on the remittance file. Treasury is re-issuing the payment and expects the new outbound to hit beneficiary bank on 2026-10-21. I have attached the remittance stub we received from the treasury system.

Attachments:
- remittance_20261002.pdf (payment attempt stub; shows reference to GCP-INV-2026-0874)

Action items from Acme side:
- We will provide a bank wire trace once the re-issued outbound clears (should be available 24–72 hours after beneficiary ledger posting).
- We will also attach the VAT invoice with supplier tax ID once legal finishes the reconciliation — target 2026-10-21 EOD.

If Finance must escalate earlier, please flag the exact fallback date so we can prioritize the treasury queue.

— Sarah Lin
Head of Finance, Acme Apps Inc.

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>

Subject: RE: Stale GCP Marketplace invoices — collection queue escalation & evidence request

Thanks everyone — good progress. TL;DR and next steps: 

What we have:
- Metering export from GCP attached (gcp-metering-report-202610.csv).
- Remittance stub from Acme showing attempted payment on 2026-10-02.

Outstanding items / owners:
- Marissa: confirm the matching algorithm between GCP meter rows and our invoice lines (we need a dot-product mapping; if GCP raw pubsub is required, request that and run matching script). Deadline: 2026-10-21 12:00 PT.
- Jordan: prepare a short AR note (1 paragraph) documenting the aging and prior collection attempts; include the ledger reference numbers so Finance can trace the hold. Deadline: 2026-10-21 12:00 PT.
- Vanessa: if GCP cannot provide granular pubsub payloads quickly, open a ticket to escalate to GCP partner support — capture ticket number and contact. Deadline: 2026-10-20 EOD.
- Acme (Sarah): provide bank trace + VAT invoices by 2026-10-21 EOD.

Escalation plan: if remittance trace and VAT invoice are not received by 2026-10-25, Finance will request collections referral and issue a 7-day notice to the partner. I am attaching our internal escalation playbook for Collections (for internal reviewers only).

Attachments:
- escalation-playbook-v1.docx (internal Redwood playbook)

I'll update this thread once receipts come in or if Finance escalates.

Karthik
Head of Marketplace Operations
Redwood Inference
